import type { Database } from '#infra/database/client'
import { findDriverError, toPersistenceError } from '#infra/database/driver-error'
import { DuplicateOrderError } from '#modules/billing/errors/duplicate-order-error'
import { ORDERS_NUMBER_UNIQUE_INDEX, orders } from './schema/orders.js'

const PG_UNIQUE_VIOLATION = '23505'

export class DrizzleOrdersRepository {
  constructor(private readonly db: Database) {}

  async save(order: unknown): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.db.insert(orders).values(order)
    } catch (error) {
      const driverError = findDriverError(error)
      if (
        driverError?.code === PG_UNIQUE_VIOLATION &&
        driverError.constraint === ORDERS_NUMBER_UNIQUE_INDEX
      ) {
        throw new DuplicateOrderError()
      }

      throw toPersistenceError(error)
    }
  }
}
